What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[Bodhi Rook]]: left, the image of [[Bodhi Rook (Errata)]] (holotable commit eb9f1e8); right, the image of [[Bodhi Rook (Errata 2)]] (holotable commit 9d2c01e). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/eb9f1e88dd679e4fa7860bc7cc8b6032d3476e13/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/bodhirook.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/bodhirook.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
